name: Wave.video
tagline: Wave.video is a video marketing platform that combines a video editor, live streaming, screen recorder, and video hosting. Its AI features include automatic video resizing for different platforms, auto-subtitles, and a text-to-video creator from blog posts. Marketers use it to repurpose content across every channel.
